title: factor_attribution.v1
description: Factor-neutral performance attribution: beta/sector/size factor exposures and return contributions, plus residual (unexplained) alpha, gross and net returns. Computed through `nousergon_lib.quant.factor_risk` (OLS + Ledoit-Wolf); this schema is the phase-3 `factor_neutral_attribution` deliverable's evidence shape (alpha-engine-config-I10501). Rides on a run manifest as a MetricRecord payload. Not the phase-1 `attribution.v1` per-stage status table (crucible/report.py) - that table carries no factor decomposition.

trading_day.description: NYSE trading day the attribution window ends on.

engine.description: The module that computed this. A constant, not free text: a gate clause matches on it.

window_sessions.description: Trading-day count of the return window the factor model was fit over.

factors.description: One row per named factor: which category it belongs to, its ETF proxy, the portfolio's exposure (beta) to it, and its return contribution over the window.

proxy.description: The ETF ticker whose return series stands in for this factor. Strategy edge - named here for reproducibility, never hardcoded in the engine.

category_totals.description: Return contribution summed by factor category, plus the residual (unexplained / idiosyncratic alpha) that is not a factor category but completes the decomposition: beta + sector + size + residual == gross_return.

gross_return.description: Realized portfolio return over the window, before transaction costs.

net_return.description: gross_return net of cost_bps_total (converted from bps of book to a return fraction).

cost_bps_total.description: Transaction cost charged over the window, in bps of the book. Sourced from the same cost model `crucible.portfolio` records; carried here rather than re-priced so gross/net tie to one number.

residual_alpha.description: gross_return minus the sum of every factor's contribution_return. Duplicated at category_totals.residual for a reader that only wants the category breakdown.

risk.description: Ex-ante annualized risk decomposition from `nousergon_lib.quant.factor_risk.portfolio_risk`, computed off the same fitted model - descriptive context for the realized-return decomposition above, not itself a return.

params_digest.description: Stable digest over the attribution factor parameter set (factor->category/proxy map, benchmark proxy, shrinkage) this window was computed under.
